acceptance_criteria: TST-CHESS-01 Exhaustively round-trip all 64 squares and exercise empty and high-bit boards. Run ailang verify for bounded coordinate and index contracts and record any inconclusive result with its diagnostic.
TST-CHESS-02 Round-trip startpos and canonical Kiwipete plus a FEN with non-default counters and an en-passant field. Reject malformed ranks, side, rights, square and counters with explicit errors.
features.notes: Board round trips through all 64 squares. FEN fixtures passed. Z3 verified coordToSq, fileOf and rankOf and skipped popcount (unsupported_encoding for bitwiseXor_Int).

acceptance_criteria: TST-CHESS-03 Fixtures cover pawn, knight, king and slider attacks, file wrap, blocked rays and signed high-bit occupancy. Ordinary candidates exclude friendly squares and king captures.
features.notes: Attack fixtures passed. Cached leaper and ray arrays are built once per operation and threaded through traversal. M2 and M3 share movegen.ail.

acceptance_criteria: TST-CHESS-04 Fixtures cover pinned moves, castling through check, rights changes, en-passant discovered check, and quiet and capture promotions. Piece counts change only as implied by the move. Applying a legal move preserves the original immutable position.
features.notes: Legality and transition fixtures passed, including pin, castling safety, en-passant discovered check and promotions. Perft bulk counting agrees with materialized legal children in the special-move fixtures.

acceptance_criteria: TST-CHESS-05 Fast regression counts are startpos depths 1–3 = 20, 400, 8902. Kiwipete depths 1–2 = 48, 2039. Positions 3, 4 and 5 depths 1–2 = 14/191, 6/264 and 44/1486 respectively.
TST-CHESS-06 A recorded strict-VM startpos depth-four run returns 197281. Run it outside the fast test gate. A mismatch blocks movegen acceptance.
features.notes: Published perft counts passed. Corrected Position 3 depth two to 191. Strict VM returned 197281 at startpos depth four.

acceptance_criteria: TST-CHESS-07 Fixed-depth fixtures cover a forced mate, stalemate, checked quiescence and stable ties. Every returned move belongs to the root legal list and every PV ply replays legally. Repeated runs return identical move, score and PV.
features.notes: Search fixtures passed for mate, stalemate, legal PV replay, check evasions at the quiescence horizon and stable ordering.

acceptance_criteria: TST-CHESS-08 Compare stdout byte-for-byte across two evaluator runs and two strict VM runs using one fixture. Cover valid commands, malformed FEN retaining the last valid position, invalid depth, unknown command, quit and EOF. Use count-only output for perft and keep timing outside replay stdout. Test quit and EOF in separate fixtures so both paths execute.

TST-CHESS-09 Record startpos depths 3 and 4 for evaluator and strict VM in the README and the design implementation record. Include commit, machine, CLI version, commands, counts, elapsed seconds and nodes/sec. If depth four exceeds 30 minutes, schedule and record the completed manual run outside CI. The exact count remains required.
